rule.name: JpaEnumString
rule.message: Write @Enumerated(EnumType.STRING) on this enum field or element collection, and @MapKeyEnumerated(EnumType.STRING) on a map with enum keys. The default stores the ordinal, so adding or reordering constants silently corrupts stored rows.

property.name: xpath
property.value: let $fields := //ClassDeclaration[ModifierList/Annotation[ (pmd-java:typeIs('jakarta.persistence.Entity') or pmd-java:typeIs('javax.persistence.Entity')) or (pmd-java:typeIs('jakarta.persistence.Embeddable') or pmd-java:typeIs('javax.persistence.Embeddable')) or (pmd-java:typeIs('jakarta.persistence.MappedSuperclass') or pmd-java:typeIs('javax.persistence.MappedSuperclass'))]] [not(ClassBody/MethodDeclaration/ModifierList/Annotation[(pmd-java:typeIs('jakarta.persistence.Id') or pmd-java:typeIs('javax.persistence.Id'))])] /ClassBody/FieldDeclaration[not(pmd-java:modifiers() = ('static', 'transient'))] [not(ModifierList/Annotation[ (pmd-java:typeIs('jakarta.persistence.Transient') or pmd-java:typeIs('javax.persistence.Transient')) or (pmd-java:typeIs('jakarta.persistence.Convert') or pmd-java:typeIs('javax.persistence.Convert')) or pmd-java:typeIs('org.hibernate.annotations.JdbcTypeCode') or pmd-java:typeIs('org.hibernate.annotations.JdbcType') or pmd-java:typeIs('org.hibernate.annotations.Type')])], $converters := //ClassDeclaration[ModifierList/Annotation[(pmd-java:typeIs('jakarta.persistence.Converter') or pmd-java:typeIs('javax.persistence.Converter'))] [AnnotationMemberList/MemberValuePair[@Name = 'autoApply']/BooleanLiteral[@True = true()]]], $converted := ( $converters/ImplementsList/ClassType[(pmd-java:typeIs('jakarta.persistence.AttributeConverter') or pmd-java:typeIs('javax.persistence.AttributeConverter'))]/TypeArguments/ClassType[1]/@SimpleName, for $extended in $converters/ExtendsList/ClassType[(pmd-java:typeIs('jakarta.persistence.AttributeConverter') or pmd-java:typeIs('javax.persistence.AttributeConverter'))] return let $base := (//ClassDeclaration[@SimpleName = $extended/@SimpleName])[1], $argument := string(($base/ImplementsList/ClassType[(pmd-java:typeIs('jakarta.persistence.AttributeConverter') or pmd-java:typeIs('javax.persistence.AttributeConverter'))]/TypeArguments/ClassType[1]/@SimpleName)[1]), $index := index-of($base/TypeParameters/TypeParameter/@Name, $argument) return if (empty($base)) then $extended/TypeArguments/ClassType/@SimpleName else if (empty($index)) then $argument else $extended/TypeArguments/*[$index[1]]/@SimpleName), $string := function($field) { exists($field/ModifierList/Annotation[pmd-java:typeIs('jakarta.persistence.Enumerated') or pmd-java:typeIs('javax.persistence.Enumerated')] [.//*[@Name = 'STRING']]) }, $stringKey := function($field) { exists($field/ModifierList/Annotation[pmd-java:typeIs('jakarta.persistence.MapKeyEnumerated') or pmd-java:typeIs('javax.persistence.MapKeyEnumerated')] [.//*[@Name = 'STRING']]) }, $collections := $fields[ModifierList/Annotation[pmd-java:typeIs('jakarta.persistence.ElementCollection') or pmd-java:typeIs('javax.persistence.ElementCollection')]] return ( $fields[not($string(.))]/ClassType[pmd-java:typeIs('java.lang.Enum')] | $collections[not($string(.))]/ClassType[not(pmd-java:typeIs('java.util.Map'))]/TypeArguments/*[1] | $collections[not($string(.))]/ClassType[pmd-java:typeIs('java.util.Map')]/TypeArguments/*[2] | $collections[not($stringKey(.))]/ClassType[pmd-java:typeIs('java.util.Map')]/TypeArguments/*[1] )[self::ClassType[pmd-java:typeIs('java.lang.Enum')]][not(@SimpleName = $converted)]
